overview: You answered Anne's January question first, as Gilbert had told you to. You will come at Lent, before Mid-Lent Sunday, and you named no day. You told her the playing stops on Shrove Tuesday, that the Queen's money may be mid-March, and the comedy in four lines. The sheet is dated the 16th of February 1594. It waits in the room for the carrier of the 27th.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the letter, dated it the 16th of February 1594, and did not give it to a carrier.

parties.name: Anne Shakespeare
parties.context: Is the person addressed, and is not in the room.

parties.name: Gilbert Shakespeare
parties.context: Is named as the one who bid him answer the last question first, and is not in the room.

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Wrote Anne of coming before Mid-Lent Sunday

summary: Wrote Anne of coming before Mid-Lent Sunday
